input:
Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候有一个人叫神农。他需要当上医，一看别的人就想帮助他们。但是，他有一个问题，他不知道什么东西能做药。神农听说一个远远的地方有一种植物，什么病人吃都会觉得身体更好。神农三个月走去，找到有植物的地方，他看到一个很漂亮的植物，又香又好看。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 他需要当上医：医生
- 一看别的人就想帮助他们：看到，看look vs.看到see; 病人，“别的” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”
- 什么病人吃都会觉得身体更好：吃了以后
- 神农三个月走去：走了三个月

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代的时候：在古代，this phrase redundantly combines two time expressions; use the shorter time expression. [rule: time_expression]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 当上医：当上医生，医 is not the usual standalone noun for this occupation; 医生 means “doctor.” [rule: word_choice]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 别的人：别人，别的 is used to distinguish other items or people from a stated one; here the intended general meaning is “other people.” [teacher rule: bieren]
4. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 一看：一看到，看 describes looking, while 看到 expresses the result of seeing someone. [rule: resultative_complement]
5. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 听说一个远远的地方有：听说在一个很远的地方有，use 在 to introduce the location; 很远的 is the natural modifier for a distant place in this sentence. [rule: none]
6. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 一个很漂亮的植物：一株很漂亮的植物，株 is an appropriate measure word for one individual plant. [rule: none]
7. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 神农听说：他听说，after the immediately preceding reference to him and with no competing character, use a pronoun for this re-occurrence. [rule: none]
8. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 神农三个月走去：他三个月走去，he is still the only active character, so repeating the name so soon is unnecessary; use a pronoun. [rule: none]
9. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 什么病人吃都会：什么病人吃了都会，eating is completed before the patients feel better, so use 了 for the completed action. [rule: aspect_le_completed]
10. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 三个月走去，找到有植物的地方：走了三个月，找到了有植物的地方，place the duration after the verb and use 了 to show that the journey and the finding were completed. [rule: aspect_le_completed]

items.reason: 古代的时候 redundantly combines two time expressions under the teacher's rule, and 在古代 is correct.
医 is not the appropriate standalone occupation noun here; 医生 is correct.
别的人 is wrong here, but the intended people are 病人, so changing it only to 别人 does not fully correct the wording.
The teacher requires 看到 rather than 看 here, and 一看到 correctly supplies it.
一个远远的地方有一种植物 is acceptable Chinese, while the displayed text ends incompletely at 有.
A single individual plant normally takes the measure word 株, and 一株很漂亮的植物 is correct.
神农 was mentioned recently and remains the only active person, so the teacher's reference rule requires 他.
他 is appropriate for the repeated reference, but 他三个月走去 still has the incorrect duration placement.
吃了 correctly marks eating as preceding the resulting feeling, but the displayed correction still retains 什么病人 and ends mid-predicate.
走了三个月 correctly places the duration and marks completion, and 找到了 correctly completes the final action.
